scenarios.title: A split card with fuse can be cast as both halves only from hand

setup.notes: Give is the left half of the split card Give // Take, which has fuse. All eight lands are untapped.

decisions: A considers casting Give // Take from hand with both halves chosen (cost {2}{G}{2}{U}), targeting Grizzly Bears with both halves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Give // Take as a fused split spell from hand is legal, with a total cost of {4}{G}{U}.

variants.label: from-graveyard
variants.delta: Give // Take is in A's graveyard instead of A's hand, and A has cast Snapcaster Mage (tapping two Islands) targeting it, so it has flashback until end of turn.
variants.expected: Casting only Give for its flashback cost {2}{G}, or only Take for {2}{U}, is legal; casting both halves as a fused split spell is not legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: The split card Give // Take is two faces in Forge, Name:Give and Name:Take; the hand entry stands for the whole card. Forge implements fuse with the Fuse keyword on the first face and may offer it only from hand; flashback on a split card may or may not offer each half separately, so the graveyard variant is the one to check.

scenarios.title: A fused split spell has the combined colors of both halves

setup.notes: Give is the left half of Give // Take. Give is green and Take is blue. Pyroblast's counter mode counters target spell if it is blue.

decisions: A casts Give // Take as a fused split spell, choosing both halves, targeting Grizzly Bears with both Give and Take, tapping all six lands.
A passes priority; B casts Pyroblast in counter mode targeting the fused spell, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Pyroblast resolves, then (if it is still on the stack) the split spell resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The fused split spell is blue (it has the colors of both halves), so Pyroblast counters it. Give // Take goes to A's graveyard, Grizzly Bears gets no counters and A draws no cards.

variants.label: give-only
variants.delta: A casts only the Give half (cost {2}{G}, tapping Forest, Forest, Forest, targeting Grizzly Bears) instead of both halves.
variants.expected: The spell on the stack is green only, so Pyroblast resolves and does nothing. Give resolves: Grizzly Bears gets three +1/+1 counters and is 5/5.

scenarios.forge_notes: Needs Forge to compute the color of a fused spell from both faces. In the give-only variant, A taps only three of its six lands.

scenarios.title: A fused split spell costs the sum of both halves' mana costs

setup.notes: Give is the left half of Give // Take: Give costs {2}{G}, Take costs {2}{U}. All lands are untapped.

decisions: A considers casting Give // Take from hand with both halves chosen, targeting Grizzly Bears with both halves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The fused cast is legal and costs {4}{G}{U}, six mana, which A can pay with all six lands.

variants.label: one-land-short
variants.delta: A controls only five lands (Forest, Forest, Forest, Island, Island).
variants.expected: The fused cast is not legal because the total cost is six mana. Casting only Give ({2}{G}) is legal and casting only Take ({2}{U}) is legal.

variants.label: no-blue-source
variants.delta: A's six lands are Forests only (no Island).
variants.expected: The fused cast is not legal because its total cost includes {U}, while casting only Give ({2}{G}) is legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: The split card Give // Take is two faces in Forge, Name:Give and Name:Take.

scenarios.title: A fused split spell follows the left half and then the right half

setup.notes: Give is the left half of Give // Take. Give puts three +1/+1 counters on target creature; Take removes all +1/+1 counters from target creature you control and draws that many cards.

decisions: A casts Give // Take as a fused split spell, choosing both halves, targeting Grizzly Bears with both Give and Take, tapping all six lands.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Give resolves first and puts three +1/+1 counters on Grizzly Bears, then Take removes those three counters and A draws three cards. Grizzly Bears is 2/2 with no counters, A's hand holds three Plains, and Give // Take is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: give-only
variants.delta: A casts only the Give half, tapping three lands.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has three +1/+1 counters and is 5/5. A draws no cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: The result depends on order: right half first would draw no cards.
